# netcup_maintenance (Data Source)

Scheduled SCP system maintenance window, if any (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_maintenance" "next" {}

output "maintenance_window" {
  value = "${data.netcup_maintenance.next.start_at} - ${data.netcup_maintenance.next.finish_at}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `finish_at` (String) Maintenance finish (empty if none scheduled).
- `start_at` (String) Maintenance start (empty if none scheduled).
